result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: it creates a mutual aggregate cap based on 12 months of paid-or-payable fees and preserves uncapped treatment for the cross-referenced indemnity and confidentiality provisions, gross negligence, and wilful misconduct. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 floor, data-protection, security, fraud, and mutual other-party-IP carve-outs, and the payment-obligations clarification. Although substantive unrelated terms remain effective, the rendered text unnecessarily reorders the existing limitation, indemnity, and confidentiality blocks, so it is not minimal. The drafting quality is poor because this reordering obscures section structure and makes the effectiveness of the Sections 13 and 14 cross-reference less self-evident.
